company.name: Pivot Robots
company.shortDescription: Pivot Robots uses AI vision software with robots and sensors to improve industrial automation adaptability.
company.description: Pivot Robots combines off-the-shelf robots and vision sensors with our pioneering AI vision control software to enable industrial robots to adapt. Pivot Robots accomplish this by harnessing the most recent developments in core vision models.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,862,596 to $11,675,944, a 1.7x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
